lines.speaker: Miggy
lines.text: BARKADA BONDING! Nakakuha ako ng raket bonus — hati-hati tayo sa budget pares at mami sa kanto! Walang usapang acads for 2 hours!
lines.textEn: BARKADA BONDING! I got a side-gig bonus — let us split beef pares and mami at the corner! Zero academics talk for 2 hours!

choices.text: G! Ambag ako ng ₱60 para sa softdrinks at rice! (+Barkada, ++Mental)
choices.textEn: In! Pitch in ₱60 for drinks and extra rice! (+Barkada, ++Mental)

choices.text: Libre na raw ni Miggy, so tubig lang ako pero full presence! (+Barkada)
choices.textEn: Just water for me, but 100% present for the laughs! (+Barkada)

lines.speaker: Miggy
lines.text: {name}... ngayon lang ako magiging seryoso. Kinukulang ako ng ₱300 sa exam permit bukas. Nahihiya na ako kay Bea... pwede ba akong makihiram hanggang next week?
lines.textEn: {name}... dropping the jokes for once. I am ₱300 short on my exam permit tomorrow. Too embarrassed to ask Bea... could you spot me until next week?

choices.text: Eto ₱300, Miggy! Walang iwanan sa barkada! (-₱300, ++Miggy)
choices.textEn: Here is ₱300, Miggy! Nobody gets left behind! (-₱300, ++Miggy)

choices.text: Wala rin akong ₱300, pero samahan kitang mag-part-time shift ngayon! (Play Jeepney Fare)
choices.textEn: I am broke too, so let us hustle a shift together right now! (Play Jeepney Fare)

lines.speaker: Miggy
lines.text: UTANG PAID WITH INTEREST! Eto ₱450, {name} — nakabenta ako ng sneakers ng pinsan ko at nakapasa sa exam dahil sa'yo! Solid ka talaga!
lines.textEn: DEBT PAID WITH INTEREST! Here is ₱450, {name} — I flipped my cousin's shoes and passed the exam thanks to you! Real one forever!

choices.text: Sabi ko na nga ba maaasahan ka, bro! (+₱450, ++Mental)
choices.textEn: Knew I could always count on you, bro! (+₱450, ++Mental)
